title: RB2B LinkedIn ad account walkthrough, hosted by Pete Crowley with Understory (Adam absent)
summary: Pete Crowley (RB2B growth lead) and Understory agencies Ali and Alex walk through RB2B's LinkedIn thought-leader ad account, covering personas, spend scaling, bidding and attribution. Adam Robinson is away in the woods and does not speak; he is only referenced by others, so nothing is attributable to him.
